replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. Even now, thinking about complex math problems makes me feel a bit overwhelmed. This is a bit beyond me, but I’d guess you’d start by finding the derivative of the function, f'(x). Then, set f'(x) equal to zero and solve for x. Those x-values would be the stationary points. However, I’d need to double-check this because it sounds more complicated than I remember.
